overview.title: About Sadat City
overview.paragraph1: Sadat City is one of Egypt's most important first-generation cities, located in Monufia Governorate, 90 km northwest of Cairo. Founded in 1978, it has been experiencing rapid urban and investment growth in recent years.
overview.paragraph2: The city features modern infrastructure and a road network connecting it to Cairo, Alexandria, and the Delta. With a growing population and new projects, Sadat City has become an ideal destination for living and real estate investment.

whySadat.title: Why Sadat City?
whySadat.subtitle: Reasons that make Sadat City the ideal choice for living and investment

reason1.title: Competitive Prices
reason1.description: Property prices 75% lower compared to New Cairo and Fifth Settlement

reason2.title: Strategic Location
reason2.description: 90 km from Cairo and 120 km from Alexandria via highways

reason3.title: Modern Infrastructure
reason3.description: Wide, planned streets and an advanced utilities network

reason4.title: Complete Services
reason4.description: Universities, schools, hospitals, commercial and entertainment centers

reason5.title: Investment Opportunities
reason5.description: 33% annual property price growth with EGP 5+ billion in private investment

reason6.title: Quiet Environment
reason6.description: Vast green spaces and tranquility away from big city congestion

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure & Transportation
infrastructure.content: Sadat City features a modern road network including the Cairo-Alexandria Desert Road and the Cairo-Alexandria Agricultural Road. It is also connected by a railway line to Cairo and Upper Egypt. The city is divided into carefully planned residential, industrial, and commercial zones.

education.title: Education & Universities
education.content: The city hosts several distinguished educational institutions including Sadat City University, Al-Reyada University, and multiple higher institutes. In addition to public, private, and international schools covering all educational levels.

healthcare.title: Healthcare
healthcare.content: The city offers public and private hospitals and specialized medical centers. Notable facilities include Sadat City General Hospital and Sadat University Teaching Hospital, along with private clinics and medical centers.

commercial.title: Shopping & Commerce
commercial.content: The city features multiple commercial centers, modern malls, and traditional markets. All major brands, shops, and restaurants are available to meet residents' daily needs.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What are apartment prices in Sadat City?
faq.a1: Apartment prices in Sadat City start at approximately EGP 11,500 per square meter, making it one of the most affordable options compared to New Cairo, 6th of October City, and the New Administrative Capital.
faq.q2: Which zones does Al-Ahram Developments operate in Sadat City?
faq.a2: Al-Ahram Developments has projects in Zone 21 (The Golden Zone), Strip 7, Homeland 7, Zone 14, Zone 22, Zone 29, Al-Rawda, and Zone 35.
faq.q3: Does Al-Ahram offer interest-free installment plans?
faq.a3: Yes, Al-Ahram Developments offers flexible interest-free installment plans of up to 7 years, with a down payment starting from only 20% of the unit value.
faq.a4: Sadat City is located in Monufia Governorate, 90 km northwest of Cairo. It is easily accessible via the Cairo-Alexandria Desert Road and the Agricultural Road.
faq.q5: How long does unit delivery take?
faq.a5: Delivery timelines range from 2 to 3 years depending on the project and construction phase. You can track progress on our Construction Updates page.
faq.q6: How can I contact Al-Ahram Developments?
faq.a6: You can reach us via WhatsApp, phone call, or through the contact form on our website. Our team is available seven days a week from 9 AM to 6 PM.
faq.q7: What are the advantages of living in Sadat City?
faq.a7: Sadat City offers a peaceful environment with wide green spaces, modern infrastructure, universities, schools, hospitals, and commercial centers — all at prices significantly lower than major urban cities.
faq.q8: Are Al-Ahram projects officially licensed and approved?
faq.a8: Yes, all Al-Ahram Developments projects are officially licensed and approved by the relevant government authorities in Sadat City, operating under valid official permits.

faq.title: Payment FAQ
faq.q1: What is the minimum down payment?
faq.a1: The down payment starts from 20% of the total unit value in the developer installment plan. For bank financing, the down payment can be as low as 20% depending on the financing bank.
faq.q2: Can I change the payment plan after signing?
faq.a2: Yes, you can contact our sales team to discuss adjusting your payment plan according to your financial circumstances. We strive to provide maximum flexibility for our clients.
faq.q3: What documents are required for installment?
faq.a3: For developer installment: copy of national ID + utility receipt. For bank financing: national ID + income certificate + bank statement for the last 6 months.
faq.q4: Is there a penalty for early repayment?
faq.a4: There are no penalties for early repayment in the developer installment plan. In fact, we offer an additional discount for early repayment of remaining installments.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Al-Ahram for Development & Real Estate Investment is committed to protecting the privacy of our website visitors and clients. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect the personal information you provide to us through our website or through direct communication with us.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content: We collect information that you voluntarily provide when using the contact form on our website, including: full name, phone number, and message. We do not collect any sensitive information such as payment details or national ID numbers through our website.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.content: We use the information we collect for the following purposes: responding to your inquiries about our residential projects, contacting you regarding new offers and projects, improving our services and user experience on our website, and complying with legal and regulatory requirements.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We take appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of data transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure, and we do our best to protect your data.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: Our website may use cookies to improve your browsing experience and remember your preferences such as language and theme. You can control cookie settings through your browser.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access the personal information we hold about you, and to request its correction or deletion. You may also object to the processing of your data or request its restriction. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the contact information below.
